# Rally — inspiration only

Academies. Motion personality: tactile. Squash and stretch, bounce, a short confetti burst. No 3D camera, no scan line, no flap.

## Look at

- IKEA Spain, “Convive mejor,” FWA, February 2026. A form that plays without losing the task. https://thefwa.com/article/insights-ikea-convive-mejor
- Adrian Vlasov, FWA submission August 2026. Physics and play as the interface, not a sprinkle. https://thefwa.com/cases/adrian-vlasov-portfolio
- Creative Alive, 2026 motion UX. Spring and haptic-style feedback. Lottie for one-shots, Rive for state machines. We use neither file format. https://creativealive.com/micro-interactions-2026-motion-ux-rules/
- Dribbble and Pinterest candy-button boards, as described in 2026 trend roundups. Chunky press, bright pairs. We do not download the shots.

## We will write

Ink ground, coral, and butter yellow. Press squashes, release overshoots, success throws a handful of squares. Radius stays chunky.

## We will not write

A white kids’ template, a Lottie JSON, or another theme’s ease.
